name: UPR-8: a project created via POST /api/projects is not the default project (422 codx_path_required)
description:
Verified against your tree (image codxjunior/codx-junior:build-check @ 325e7e5, workspace_api.contract_version: 1). UPR-2…UPR-7 all behave as documented — thank you. This is the single remaining gap, reported as UPR-8 in docs/change-requests/2026-11-22-codx-junior-platform-followup.md and as case WS-08 in our UAT (run 20261122T111209-7eba47: 33 passed, 0 failed, 1 gap).

WHAT HAPPENS (fresh workspace, empty projects folder)

POST /api/projects?project_path=<projects>/demo  -> 200
POST /api/chats/tasks  (no codx_path)  -> HTTP 422
  {"detail":{"code":"codx_path_required",
   "message":"A project is required: pass ?codx_path=<project> or …"}}

GET /api/projects                                   -> {"projects":[]}   (the project we just created is missing)
GET /api/health -> workspace_api.default_codx_path  -> null

Passing the explicit path works, so the project, the admin permission and the task endpoint are all fine:
POST /api/chats/tasks?codx_path=<projects>/demo/.codx -> 200 {"id":"…"}
POST /api/chats/tasks?codx_path=<projects>/demo       -> 200 {"id":"…"}

WHY IT MATTERS TO US
Our customer flow is: workspace provisioned -> customer (or our console, with the scoped workspace token) creates the first project -> creates the first task. The second step is exactly the one that fails, and it fails with a 422 that tells the caller to do something they already did. On a hosted box it looks like "the workspace is broken" on the very first action, minutes after we handed the customer a working URL.

LIKELY CAUSE (from your code, for triage)
The process-wide discovery snapshot is initialised empty at startup and find_all_projects(force=False) serves it for DISCOVERY_TTL_SECONDS (600 s). POST /api/projects emits a collection event, but project_manager.create_project does not call update_project_snapshot() in the API process (only traefik/project_cache.py and company/assistant.py do). default_codx_path(allow_scan=True) then calls find_all_projects() without force=True, so it returns the cached empty map instead of scanning. The same stale snapshot is why GET /api/projects returns [] and workspace_api.default_codx_path stays null.

EXPECTED
- a project created through POST /api/projects is immediately the default project for POST /api/chats/tasks WITHOUT codx_path
- GET /api/projects shows it immediately
- GET /api/health.workspace_api.default_codx_path is non-null once a project exists
- this holds for the FIRST project in a fresh workspace, not only after a restart or after the discovery TTL

SUGGESTED FIX (small)
1. In project_manager.create_project, after new_project is built, call update_project_snapshot(new_project) — the same call the Traefik cache path makes. That fixes every consumer, not only the project list.
2. Belt and braces: default_codx_path / resolve_workspace_codx_path may use find_all_projects(force=True) when the snapshot is empty but the projects root contains a .codx/project.json. Request paths can pay one bounded scan; /api/health should not.
3. Invalidate _ALL_PROJECTS_UPDATED_AT when a snapshot is inserted, so a subsequent TTL-based refresh cannot overwrite the insertion with stale data.

ACCEPTANCE
  curl -fsS $B/api/health | jq .workspace_api.default_codx_path          # null
  curl -fsS -X POST "$B/api/projects?project_path=$B_PROJECTS/demo" -H "Authorization: Bearer $T"   # 200
  curl -fsS $B/api/projects -H "Authorization: Bearer $T" | jq '.projects[].codx_path'              # includes demo
  curl -fsS -X POST $B/api/chats/tasks -H "Authorization: Bearer $T" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
       -d '{"name":"first task","description":"no codx_path"}'                                       # 200 + id
  curl -fsS $B/api/health | jq .workspace_api.default_codx_path                                    # non-null
=> our UAT should go from "33 passed, 0 failed, 1 gap" to "34 passed, 0 failed, 0 gaps".

ALSO NOTICED (minor, same instance — no extra ticket, fix if cheap)
- GET /api/project/watch -> 500 (error_id 851dc58869c7) when called to force a discovery refresh; if it is meant for that, it should not crash; if deprecated, a 4xx or a documented alternative would be clearer
- POST /api/projects returns abs_project_path in the response but the saved project.json carries abs_project_path: "" (it did not block the explicit-path flow)
